title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.20191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed Decision Models such as TypeSafe's Jev, also called System One or System 1 models, answer typed questions about an input with a probability for each option, and they need no training. Many NLP papers still fine-tune a task-specific classifier, and prompted large language models (LLMs) trail such classifiers on most text classification benchmarks. We ask how many of these fine-tuned classifiers a Typed Decision Model can replace under each paper's own evaluation, and what is needed where it cannot. We swap the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers for Jev, keep each paper's splits, label definitions and metric, and check the results with Cloudflare's Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions. The resulting 46 English test sets, with their questions and published scores, form the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark. translated_title: 我们还需要微调的分类器吗？将类型化决策模型替换进24篇ACL会议论文
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型（如TypeSafe的Jev，也称为System One或System 1模型）通过为每个选项给出概率来回答关于输入的类型化问题，并且无需任何训练。许多NLP论文仍在微调任务特定的分类器，而经提示的大语言模型（LLM）在大多数文本分类基准上落后于这类分类器。我们探究在每篇论文自身的评估设置下，一个类型化决策模型能替代多少这样的微调分类器，以及在无法替代时需要什么条件。我们将24篇ACL会议论文中的预测器替换为Jev，保留每篇论文原有的数据划分、标签定义和评估指标，并使用Cloudflare的Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1和OpenAI的GPT-6 Luna Decisions核验结果。由此产生的46个英语测试集，连同其问题与已发表的分数，构成了TDM-Gauntlet基准。在零样本提示下，Jev在46个测试集中的12个上直接取代了原论文的预测器，这些大多是单一判断类任务
tldr: 该研究将无需训练的类型化决策模型Jev替换进24篇ACL会议论文的微调分类器位置，构建了包含46个英语测试集的TDM-Gauntlet基准，发现零样本提示下Jev已在12个测试集上直接取代原论文的预测器。
en_tdlr: This study swaps the training-free Typed Decision Model Jev into the fine-tuned classifiers of 24 ACL-venue papers, building the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark of 46 English test sets, and shows that with a zero-shot prompt Jev directly replaces the original predictor on 12 of them.
